commands.review_summary:
The PR changes flagless interactive CLI onboarding to a guided live-verification flow with masked manual API-key setup, classic wizard verification, Crestodian setup/channel handoffs, token sensitivity, docs, and tests.

PR surface: Source +1041, Tests +933, Docs +114. Total +2088 across 37 files.

Reproducibility: yes. source-reproducible: current main chooses a detected model without live testing, while the PR-head code shows the remaining env-key durability and classic workspace-verifier failure paths without needing to run mutating tests.

target.title: feat(onboard): guided CLI onboarding with live AI verification and classic fallback
target.body:
Closes #101851

## What Problem This Solves

The macOS app's first-run "Connect your AI" step live-tests every AI backend with a real completion before saving anything, falls through automatically when a candidate fails, and verifies manually entered keys before storing them. The CLI had none of that: interactive onboarding (Crestodian chat since #99935) persisted the first *detected* credential without any live test — a stale `OPENAI_API_KEY`, an expired CLI login, or a billing-dead account became the configured default model, and the failure only surfaced on the first real agent turn. A fresh machine with no CLI logins dead-ended entirely: the chat TUI takes no masked input, so there was no way to enter and verify an API key during CLI onboarding. Docs still described pre-#99935 routing (classic as the fresh-install default).

## Why This Change Was Made

Interactive `openclaw onboard` (and bare `openclaw` on a fresh install) now runs a guided flow driving the same engine the macOS app uses (`detectSetupInference`/`activateSetupInference`, `surface: "cli"`): risk acknowledgement → workspace → detect existing AI access → live-test the recommended candidate with a real "reply OK" completion → on failure show the mapped reason (auth/rate limit/billing/timeout) and automatically try the next usable candidate → when detection is exhausted, offer every remaining/failed candidate for retry, a masked and live-verified manual API-key step built from installed provider manifests, Crestodian chat, the classic step-by-step wizard, or skip-AI. Model + workspace + quickstart gateway are persisted only after a passing test; a failing candidate never touches config. The classic wizard keeps its full surface and gains an optional post-auth live verification (never blocks completion). Candidate live-tests are classified as probes so expected failures stay out of the wizard TTY (file diagnostics unchanged), and the classic escape carries the already-collected risk acknowledgement instead of re-prompting. No new flags, config keys, or protocol changes; `--classic`, `--modern`, `--non-interactive`, and all scripted flags behave exactly as before.

## User Impact

Fresh installs get a first chat that actually works: onboarding proves inference before claiming success, explains provider failures in plain language as it walks the ladder, and accepts a manually pasted key with masked input and the same verification — on every platform, not just macOS. Re-running `openclaw onboard` on a configured install now doubles as a verify/repair pass for the current model. Classic-wizard users can confirm their model answers before finishing setup.

## Evidence

Live E2E on a clean Linux box (AWS Crabbox `cbx_114157c63e3d`, packaged tarball via `scripts/package-openclaw-for-docker.mjs` + `npm i -g`, real API keys, driven over tmux):

- **Guided happy path (live OpenAI key):** detect → live test ("replied in 2.9s") → persisted `openai/gpt-5.5`, workspace, quickstart gateway (token auth), bootstrap files seeded, clean exit 0.
- **Ladder walk-down (invalid OpenAI + live Anthropic):** OpenAI candidate fails with HTTP 401 → "✗ OpenAI API key: Authentication failed. Sign in again or check the key." → automatic fall-through → Anthropic passes ("replied in 1.8s") → `anthropic/claude-opus-4-8` persisted; the failing candidate never reached config; no diagnostics leak into the TTY (re-verified after the probe-lane fix: leak count 0).
- **Manual masked key (no env creds):** "No existing AI access" → provider picker from installed manifests → masked key entry → live verify passed → credential persisted to the per-agent SQLite store; key value confirmed absent from every terminal capture.
- **Classic wizard + new verify step (`--classic --flow quickstart`):** env-key detection, Codex runtime plugin auto-install from the packaged tarball, model configured, then "Test AI access now with a live completion?" → "AI access works. Replied in 3.0s."
- **Classic escape from guided:** lands in the classic flow selection without re-asking the risk acknowledgement.

Screenshots (full set + [manifest](https://artifacts.openclaw.ai/pr-101880/artifact-manifest.json)):

| | |
|---|---|
| Walk-down: OpenAI fails with mapped reason, Anthropic test starts | ![walkdown failure](https://artifacts.openclaw.ai/pr-101880/02-walkdown-openai-fails-with-reason.png) |
| Walk-down: Anthropic verified, setup applied, honest gateway state | ![walkdown success](https://artifacts.openclaw.ai/pr-101880/03-walkdown-anthropic-verified-and-applied.png) |
| Manual path: full flow with masked key entry | ![masked key](https://artifacts.openclaw.ai/pr-101880/01-guided-flow-manual-masked-key.png) |
| Classic wizard: new live verification step passes | ![classic verify](https://artifacts.openclaw.ai/pr-101880/06-classic-live-verify-works.png) |
| Classic escape from guided (no risk re-prompt) | ![classic escape](https://artifacts.openclaw.ai/pr-101880/07-classic-escape-no-reprompt.png) |
| Guided security notice | ![security](https://artifacts.openclaw.ai/pr-101880/04-guided-security-notice.png) |
| Classic auth groups | ![auth groups](https://artifacts.openclaw.ai/pr-101880/05-classic-wizard-auth-groups.png) |

Gates: `pnpm check:changed` exit 0 on the final head (lease `tbx_01kwz4d92mmtswkykjbg7wm2pe`, Testbox-through-Crabbox). `pnpm test:changed` on the same lease: 3 failures, all pre-existing on `main` and unrelated — the affected `src/plugins/**` files are byte-identical to `origin/main`; they encode the host's `/tmp/openclaw` state in `os.tmpdir()` assertions and fail on any machine where `/tmp/openclaw` is ownable (two-way proof + mechanism in #101876, follow-up filed). Everything else passed (e.g. gateway+agents projects: 270 files / 3296 tests green; an intermittent vitest "Worker exited unexpectedly" crash-at-shutdown on the Testbox can poison exit codes while all tests pass — observed at varying positions across runs, also unrelated to this diff). Autoreview (branch mode vs origin/main) ran to completion; its one finding (existing-model verification runs outside the configured workspace and could let the ladder silently replace a workspace-backed model) was addressed in f0342c45256 by failing safe: a failed current-model check stops the auto-ladder and asks, never auto-replacing the configured default.

Focused suites locally green throughout (`node scripts/run-vitest.mjs` on onboard-guided, onboard, onboard-interactive, setup-inference, wizard setup, register.onboard, i18n, command-queue, logging subsystem). Known proof gap: gateway service install on the E2E box fails (`systemctl --user` unavailable on the headless host) — the flow reports it honestly and continues; daemon install itself is untouched by this PR.



---

## Update: two-way switching + channel-setup guidance

The chat and the menu wizards are now fully interchangeable, and the assistant can guide channel setup with real metadata instead of guesses:

- **Chat → menus:** `open setup wizard` (guided), `open classic wizard`, and `open channel wizard for <channel>` are new typed operations plus a ring-zero `open_setup` action; the chat TUI tears down first and the wizard launches in its place (mirrors the existing `talk to agent` handoff; the gateway/macOS chat surface returns a text pointer instead). Workspace and the already-collected risk acknowledgement carry across the switch.
- **Sensitive-step switch instead of dead end:** the hosted channel wizard used to cancel at the first secret and tell you to run a command yourself; now it offers `open channel wizard`, remembers the channel, and hands off into the masked `channels add` wizard (which now preselects that channel).
- **Channel competence:** new read-only `channel info <channel>` operation and `channel_info` ring-zero action surface the channel's label, blurb, configured/installed state, and its real `docs.openclaw.ai/channels/...` URL from channel-setup discovery. Both prompts instruct the assistant: asking *about* a channel → `channel info` + docs link; asking to *connect* → start the wizard directly (the distinction came from a live-test failure where the agent detoured a connect request through info).
- **Security fix found by the live test:** the shared channel-token prompt lacked `sensitive: true`, so terminal wizards echoed pasted tokens and the chat bridge hosted a Telegram token step in visible plain text. Fixed with a regression test asserting every token prompt is sensitive; pre-existing on `main` but load-bearing for the masked-wizard contract this PR documents.
- Docs updated across `cli/crestodian`, `cli/onboard`, `start/wizard`, and `start/onboarding-overview` to describe the interchangeable flows and new commands.

Live proof (fresh Linux box, packaged tarball, real OpenAI key, tmux-driven):

| | |
|---|---|
| Natural "how do I set up slack?" → agent runs `channel info slack`, cites real docs URL | ![slack question](https://artifacts.openclaw.ai/pr-101880/11-agent-slack-question-channel-info.png) |
| `connect telegram` reaches the token step → guard fires with the switch offer | ![sensitive offer](https://artifacts.openclaw.ai/pr-101880/08-chat-sensitive-step-offers-switch.png) |
| `open channel wizard` → chat exits, masked channel wizard opens | ![masked wizard](https://artifacts.openclaw.ai/pr-101880/09-chat-to-masked-channel-wizard.png) |
| `open setup wizard` → chat hands off to guided onboarding | ![chat to guided](https://artifacts.openclaw.ai/pr-101880/10-chat-to-guided-setup-switch.png) |

Gates: `check:changed` green on the update head (Testbox-through-Crabbox); `test:changed` green except five failures pre-existing on `main` with unchanged files, all filed: #101876 (plugins `/tmp/openclaw` env-coupled assertions), #101965 (browser navigation-guard vs SSRF tightening from #100835), #101966 (Slack thread-session-key ACP routing). Focused suites for every touched surface pass locally. Branch autoreview surfaced one finding (the guided flow could launch the chat TUI while the wizard prompter still owned the terminal) — fixed in 422e1b43b45 by mirroring the classic finalize pre/post terminal restore.
